summary: Release writer admission during mutation bodies and non-writing waits

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: Admission and future dispatch are process-local. Storage version, schema and digests are unchanged.

rules.detail: Foreground ordering, fences, loan classes and checkpoint drop/proof rules are unchanged. Checkpoint planning uses the same captured sealed set and outer allocator completion boundary.

compatibility.detail: Mutation handlers admit synchronous future polls before spawn_blocking, releasing worker and capacity on Pending. Slow bodies, services and mutex waits cannot retain every writer slot. Non-writing publication/git preflight, provider/control effects, native predecessor termination, gate startup, attestation and scratch checkpoint proof run without live-writer capacity. Request/result receipts, session fences, dependent writer capacity sharing and detached mutation completion are preserved. Read long polls retain their separate existing path; no global blocking cap is added.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

manual.detail: No additional setup. SMALLCLAIMS_MAX_WRITE_WORKERS retains the default of 32 and its documented invalid/zero fallback.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration. Mutation completion survives dropped request waiters while service futures are pending.
